article.title_en: Mount Moriah Seventh Day Adventist Church: food pantry in Queens
article.summary_es: La Iglesia Mount Moriah Adventista del Séptimo Día aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC como despensa de alimentos en Queens. Reparte alimentos los sábados por la mañana, solo el primer y tercer sábado del mes.
article.summary_en: Mount Moriah Seventh Day Adventist Church appears on the Food Help NYC map as a food pantry in Queens. It gives out food on Saturday mornings, only on the 1st and 3rd Saturday of the month.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos según el mapa Food Help NYC de la Ciudad.
Está ubicada en 1834 Decatur Stree, NY 11385, en Queens.
Abre los sábados de 8:30 am a 9:30 am, solo el primer y tercer sábado del mes.
Puede llamar al (347) 217-4988 para preguntar antes de ir.
La lista no indica qué alimentos entrega ni si pide algún requisito.
how_they_help_en: It is listed as a food pantry on the City's Food Help NYC map.
It is located at 1834 DECATUR STREE, NY 11385, in Queens.
It is open Saturdays 8:30am-9:30am, 1st and 3rd Saturday only.
You can call (347) 217-4988 to ask before you go.
The listing does not say what food is given or if there are any requirements.
